Hi all,

Thanks for the note. Karthik from Privacy here. Quick summary of how Redwood treats these requests and next steps:

1) Controller vs Processor mapping
- For API-hosted customer payloads and customer-managed content, Acme is the controller and Redwood acts as a processor under the DPA.
- For Redwood marketing and candidate records (if any Acme users are in our CRM), Redwood is the controller for those records. We will produce a mapping table for the data categories you requested.

2) Evidence & authentication
- For access requests we need either: an ID + confirmation from Acme HR OR evidence of authority via a signed DSR (signed by an authorized Acme representative). The attached acme_dsr_form.pdf helps here.

3) Export scope and format
- We can provide machine-readable exports (JSON/CSV) of account metadata, API payloads retained in our primary storage, and user metadata. Logs are aggregated — we can provide per-account request logs for the retention window (default 90 days) and a best-effort export for longer-term backups subject to backup retention policies.

4) Deletion process and timeline
- Proposed plan: 1) Receive confirmation of account_id/tenant id + proof of authority; 2) create export job and provide archive link within 7 business days; 3) schedule deletion across live systems within 14 business days after export confirmation; 4) backup scrub (if applicable) within 30 calendar days depending on provider snapshot schedules.

5) Required inputs from Acme
- account_id or tenant id
- confirmation of authority (signed DSR or HR letter)
- indication if you require deletion from backups and timestamps to target

Action items for Redwood (owner in parentheses):
- Create tracking ticket in HubSpot and Drive folder (Jonas)
- Run account-level export job and share archive (Privacy/Ops)
- Plan deletion job and confirm cutoff windows for provider snapshots (Security/Ops)

I will take point on the export and will follow up with an internal runbook snippet and the format of the export. Marcus — can you advise on backup snapshot timelines for our GCP/AWS regions (EU)?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Privacy Counsel — Redwood Inference
